data.summary: The figures I checked match NVIDIA's reported fiscal 2024 results: revenue of $60.9B, up about 125.9% from $27.0B; net income of $29.8B; operating income of $33.0B; and cash and equivalents of $7.3B. I didn't review total assets because the user said it was already verified. Its unit may still be worth checking: the text says $65.7 million, but the reported figure was about $65.7 billion.
